אינדקס

iNDEX, a TMX VettaFi company, specializes in the research and development of unique passive investment indices. These indices serve as the underlying benchmarks for over 230 tracking funds traded on the Tel Aviv, London, and Frankfurt stock exchanges, as well as various pension savings tracks. iNDEX collaborates with leading financial institutions both in Israel and globally. Total assets tracking iNDEX indices exceed 60 billion NIS.

גלול למטה

High-Quality Indices: The Foundation of Passive Investment

iNDEX provides access to a wide range of tailored indices, ranging from leading equity and bond benchmarks to unique indices built on defined factors. Our indices enable investors to construct diversified portfolios and gain targeted exposure to specific sectors or investment strategies, while capitalizing on market opportunities and adapting to the dynamic shifts of the global economy.

Developing Indices for Investors

iNDEX indices are developed to provide precise solutions for a wide range of investment needs. Today, they serve as the underlying assets for more than 250 mutual funds, provident funds, pension funds, and other financial instruments, which manage a cumulative total of over 60 billion NIS in assets.

Cutting-Edge Research and Advanced Technology

iNDEX indices are a synthesis of professional research, proven investment strategies, and advanced technology. By leveraging the latest academic insights and a proprietary cloud-based platform, we ensure our indices meet the most rigorous international standards, providing a reliable and efficient investment solution.

iNDEX Research and Development Ltd ("iNDEX"), part of the TMX VettaFi group, is a fintech company dedicated to engineering cutting-edge solutions for the passive investment world, catering to a diverse spectrum of investors.

about us >>>

Founded in 2015, iNDEX has become one of Israel’s fastest-growing index providers. Since 2024, it has been part of the international TMX Group, positioning the firm at the forefront of global financial innovation.

Today, over 60 billion NIS in more than 230 tracking funds and ETFs traded on the Tel Aviv, London, and Frankfurt stock exchanges follow iNDEX indices. Additionally, over 25 passive pension savings tracks are based on iNDEX benchmarks.

iNDEX indices are published across a wide range of platforms, including the world’s leading financial data providers such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv, and Markit.

We believe that passive investing should be simple, transparent, and accessible to every investor. Therefore, we develop advanced indices grounded in professional research, designed to meet the precise needs of both local and global capital markets. Our indices offer a reliable, high-quality solution for building diversified portfolios, enabling investors to benefit from broad exposure and long-term investment efficiency.
